item.title: Trump says Bolsonaro can remain in US indefinitely, calls Brazil election a 'disgrace'
item.description: Flavio Bolsonaro left Brazil after his electoral defeat, despite having led in several opinion polls. His departure came after a Brazilian Supreme Court justice ordered his passport revoked. He is also facing two federal money-laundering investigations, while police in Brazil had considered him a flight risk. The comments came as US secretary of state Marco Rubio held talks with Brazilian foreign minister Mauro Vieira. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Ecuador inicia su cuarto toque de queda del año para contener la violencia a semanas de las elecciones locales
item.description: El país inició este domingo 1 de noviembre su cuarto período de restricciones nocturnas de movilidad en lo corrido del año. Se trata de una medida que regirá durante diez días en cinco provincias de la costa, entre ellas Guayas, donde se encuentra Guayaquil, la ciudad más poblada de Ecuador. El nuevo toque de queda llega en medio de una persistente crisis de seguridad, marcada por la expansión de las organizaciones criminales y el narcotráfico, y a cuatro semanas de unas elecciones locales en las que la seguridad vuelve a ocupar un lugar central en la disputa política. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: France 24

item.description: Chancellor John Healey fails to guarantee equalisation with adult wage will happen in timeframe set out in manifesto Labour looks less likely to meet its manifesto pledge to equalise the minimum wage for younger workers before the next election, after the chancellor failed to guarantee the rise would happen within that timeframe. John Healey said on Sunday the government was still committed to the increase but failed to spell out when it would be achieved. item.title: Youth Olympic Games kick off in Dakar
item.description: The 2026 Youth Olympic Games have officially kicked off in Senegal. Crowds gathered for Saturday's opening ceremony, featuring hundreds of drummers and dancers celebrating Senegalese and wider African culture, in keeping with the Games' motto: “Africa welcomes, Dakar celebrates”. It is the first-ever Olympic sporting event to be held on the African continent, but comes as Senegal faces an economic crisis. The country's president has said he wants to turn sport into an “economic and social engine”. The Games also come amid a government crackdown on LGBTQ+ people. item.title: Third weekend of protests in France as youth-led rallies sweep Europe
item.description: France is preparing for a third weekend of protests, with 70,000 security personnel deployed to prevent a repeat of the violence seen on October 17. Shops have boarded up their premises as authorities warn of further clashes, with Halloween adding to concerns over masked demonstrators. The protests, initially driven by anger over the cost of living and poor school conditions, have broadened to include demands for greater civil liberties and the right to protest. With presidential elections six months away, authorities have tightened security and restricted demonstrations in several cities. item.description: Estados Unidos ha aprobado una propuesta de venta de 500 interceptores Patriot valorada en 2.100 millones de dólares para Ucrania, en un momento crítico para las defensas aéreas de Kiev, mientras una inusual tregua humanitaria de seis días ha permitido la salida de civiles de la ciudad ocupada de Oleshky. La jornada también ha estado marcada por la visita del presidente Volodímir Zelenski a Turquía para abordar la seguridad en el mar Negro y las perspectivas diplomáticas, en medio de combates que continúan en la mayor parte del frente. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Quad not ‘anti-China’, says Rubio as first summit in two years set before Trump-Xi talks
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Saturday that the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue, or the Quad, was not an “anti-China” coalition, as the grouping’s top diplomats finalised preparations for the leaders’ summit in the Philippines next month. Rubio’s statement comes just weeks before US President Donald Trump is scheduled to meet Chinese leader Xi Jinping in Shenzhen, China. “It is not an anti-China or anti-anybody coalition,” Rubio said at a press conference on the sidelines of the... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: ¿Qué está pasando en Polonia?: ABC de la crisis institucional tras suspensión del presidente del Constitucional
item.description: La decisión de la jueza Anna Korwin-Piotrowska de suspender de forma inmediata al presidente y al vicepresidente del Tribunal Constitucional desató una noche de protestas de políticos ultraconservadores, aliados de los magistrados suspendidos, que protagonizaron choques con la Policía. El presidente Karol Nawrocki, que se dirigía a Senegal, hizo regresar a su avión y denunció "una violación del orden constitucional". Publicado también por: El País - Internacional. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Turkey nominates former foreign minister Sinirlioglu as UN chief
item.description: Turkey has nominated its former foreign minister and UN ambassador Feridun Hadi Sinirlioglu for the position of UN secretary-general, state-media reported on Saturday. The submission was officially backed by Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan who has been particularly vocal in calling for reform of the UN Security Council. Fuente: France 24 - English.
